top_signals.title: Refiners Can’t Deliver Gas Price Relief Trump Wants, Says Stephen Schork
top_signals.summary: Stephen Schork, principal and editor at The Schork Group, says refiners have virtually no ability to increase capacity and deliver more gasoline and diesel products and lower costs for consumers. President Donald Trump scolded ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. and Chevron Corp. Monday for making too much money as oil prices surged amid the war in Iran. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: India Expands LIC Share Sale to $3.3 Billion on Strong Demand
top_signals.summary: India on Tuesday expanded the size of its share sale in state-run insurance giant to raise $3.3 billion after the base offer was oversubscribed, bolstering public finances amid challenges posed by high oil prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Pakistan Partners with Canadian Firm to Boost Domestic Heavy Crude Output
top_signals.summary: Pakistan's national Oil and Gas Development Company Limited (OGDC) has signed an agreement with a Canadian firm to deploy advanced technology to boost production from heavy crude oilfields, the largest Pakistani exploration and production firm has said. Under the agreement with Canada's Synergetic Oil Tools Inc, OGDC will deploy advanced Passive Energy Tool technology aimed at optimizing and boosting production from heavy crude oil fields, the Pakistani firm said.
